script_text: Aquarius, the universe just flipped a switch this week. Early week, Mars squares your ruler Uranus in the 9th House on Monday, creating impulsive tension — avoid risky arguments. By Tuesday, the Moon sextiles natal Venus in the 7th House, easing relationship friction. Wednesday brings the turning point: Jupiter conjunct your natal Pluto in the 1st House igniting a personal rebirth you feel within hours. Late week shifts as Mercury enters your 10th House of career Thursday, aligning with Saturn to open a promotion or financial breakthrough. The weekend rewards bold love — Venus trine Pluto in your 8th House deepens emotional intimacy Sunday. Wednesday is your power day because Jupiter conjuncts Pluto in the 1st House, amplifying everything you touch. Thursday is your worst day because Mars squares Uranus, sparking unnecessary conflict. Trust your Air-sign patience this week. Comment your sign below and follow for daily updates.
